test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Bim believed that silence was the worse** betrayal of all, even more than spoken cruelty.
solution:
The correct answer is '**3**' i.e. **Worst**. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The word "**worst**" is the superlative form of the adjective "**bad**." 
 
• In the given sentence, the context suggests a comparison of betrayal at its highest level, which requires the use of the superlative form "**worst**." 
 
• "**Worse**" is the comparative form and does not fit in this context. 
 
• "**More worse**" is grammatically incorrect as the word "worse" already implies comparison, and adding "more" creates redundancy. 
 
• "**Bad**" is the base form of the adjective and does not convey the intended degree of comparison. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Bim believed that silence was the **worst**__ betrayal of all, even more than spoken cruelty."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "More worse"** is incorrect because "worse" is already a comparative adjective, and adding "more" makes it redundant and ungrammatical. 
 
• **Option 2: "Worse"** is incorrect because it is the comparative form, and the sentence demands the superlative form to indicate the highest degree of betrayal. 
 
• **Option 4: "Bad"** is incorrect because it is the base form and does not convey the intended superlative comparison in the given sentence.
